_comment: How each statement of the appendix « Énoncés non vérifiés en Lean » is checked other than by Lean (issue #91), keyed by its finding id (\piste). nonverifies.mjs reads this file and the statuses in src/content/findings.ts: problem → problems paper; computation → computations/<dir>; status matched → published; refuted → refuted; otherwise no check planned.
